note: One idea at a time. Features arrive after this many finished visits and photo walks (save.player.plays). Jobs are taught by the story's visits the first time they appear; photo walks only use jobs the player has met, plus the weather jobs that aren't in storyJobs.

journal.title: Your journal
journal.text: Every visit's postcard goes into your journal, with how far each place has come. Letters from the village are kept there too.

walks.title: Weather postcards
walks.text: Any place you've visited can be photographed in five kinds of weather. Take a photo walk whenever you like. It's entirely optional.

level.title: Photographer level
level.text: Every postcard earns you experience. Going up a level brings flashbulbs and new looks for your postcards.

requests.title: The Noticeboard
requests.text: Committee requests are pinned here as they arrive. The neighbours leave little favours too; those are optional.

daily.title: The Daily Postcard
daily.text: A new photo walk every day, the same for everyone. Just for fun: there's no streak to keep.

travel.title: The Travel Office
travel.text: Posters of other villages that would love a visit from you, one day.

coach.loupe: Stuck? The magnifying glass shows you where to look.
coach.loupeClearer: Tap the magnifying glass for a free hint.
coach.zoom: Spread two fingers to look closer, or double-tap. “Whole scene” takes you back.
coach.score: Photo walks are scored, just for fun. Quick, careful tidying earns three stamps.
coach.combo: Quick fixes one after another make a run!
coach.flash: New! A flashbulb lights up everything that's left, just for a moment.
